items.headline: Alcaraz beats world No. 1 Zverev to win his first ATP Finals title
items.line: Carlos Alcaraz wins the Turin final 6-2, 7-6(7) on Sunday, a day after rallying past Ben Shelton in the semis.

items.headline: Michigan stuns No. 4 UCLA 18-16 in triple overtime
items.line: The Wolverines win it on a two-point conversion in the third OT, handing UCLA its first loss of the season.
items.stat: Won on a 3OT two-point try · UCLA falls to 10-1

items.headline: Nebraska knock off No. 14 Ohio State 31-28 in Lincoln
items.line: Jeremiah Smith's 165 receiving yards and two touchdowns aren't enough as the Buckeyes drop to 7-4.
items.stat: Smith: 6 rec, 165 yds, 2 TD · Ohio State now 5-3 in the Big Ten

items.headline: Bam Adebayo's triple-double extends the Heat's win streak to seven, 123-113 over OKC
items.line: Miami led wire-to-wire for a third straight game; Shai Gilgeous-Alexander and Giannis Antetokounmpo both sat out.
items.stat: 24 pts, 15 reb, 12 ast · Longest Heat win streak since 2017

items.headline: Rutgers rally to beat Penn State 25-24, ending an 18-game skid dating to 1988
items.line: Down 24-10 entering the fourth quarter at Beaver Stadium, Rutgers score 15 unanswered points.
items.stat: 15 unanswered 4th-quarter points · First win over PSU since 1988

items.headline: Washington beat No. 8 Indiana 27-24 in OT after a missed Hoosiers field goal
items.line: Indiana's Paddy McAteer misses from 37 yards in overtime, then Washington win it with a 46-yard kick in Seattle.

items.headline: Rookie Roman Kantserov gets his first NHL hat trick as Chicago beat Vancouver 6-3
items.line: He adds an assist for four points, the Blackhawks' first rookie four-point game since Connor Bedard in 2024.
items.thesis: A rookie finisher on a red-hot power play grows into a core scorer for Chicago's rebuild.
items.stat: 3 goals, 1 assist · Chicago 3-for-4 on the power play

items.headline: Josh Hart's 18th Knicks triple-double ties Michael Ray Richardson for second all-time
items.line: Karl-Anthony Towns adds 30 and 13 as New York beat Indiana 113-106 for a fifth straight win.
items.stat: 10 pts, 11 ast, 10 reb · Walt Frazier holds the record with 23

items.headline: Carolina become the first team to 100 goals and outshoot a 23rd straight opponent
items.line: A 5-2 win at Madison Square Garden passes the 1971-72 Rangers for the longest outshooting streak since 1959-60.
items.stat: 10-2-1 on the road, a franchise-best start · 12 skaters with a point

items.headline: Jake Oettinger makes 33 saves for a league-leading fifth shutout, Stars beat Pittsburgh 1-0
items.line: Joel Kiviranta's second-period tap-in holds up and Dallas win a fifth straight.
